name: Button
title: Button · Text actions / all variants & states
description: Text action button (Onest 600). primary = teal fill, brand = teal outline, secondary = neutral outline, tertiary = quiet transparent detail action, ghost = transparent, danger = red fill, link = inline teal text.
guidance: USE · Any action with a visible text label / AVOID · Icon-only control → IconButton

name: Checkbox

paperApi: checked: boolean|"indeterminate"; onCheckedChange?: (c: boolean) => void; label?; aria-label? (when no label); description?; disabled?

name: IconButton
title: IconButton · Source library / variants & states
description: Square icon-only button with a required label (aria-label + tooltip), primary/outline/ghost variants and optional alert dot. Primary uses the same action states as Button primary. `badge` is a dot (true) or a count chip (number, 99+ cap) — the topbar bell shows the unread count.
guidance: USE · Toolbar/topbar controls whose icon is unambiguous (notifications, help, close) / AVOID · The action needs words to be understood → Button with leadingIcon
paperApi: icon: IconName; label: string (required); variant?: "primary"|"outline"|"ghost" (outline); size?: "xs" 28|"sm" 32|"md" 36 (md); badge?: boolean | number; tooltip?: boolean (true)

name: RadioGroup
title: RadioGroup · Source library / variants & states
description: Single choice from a short, always-visible list of options, each with optional description.
guidance: USE · 2–5 mutually exclusive options that benefit from being visible side by side, with explanations / AVOID · More than 5 options → SelectField or Combobox
paperApi: value: string; onValueChange: (v: string) => void; options: { value, label, description?, disabled? }[]; orientation?: "vertical"|"horizontal"; aria-label?

name: Switch
title: Switch · Source library / variants & states
description: On/off toggle for settings that take effect immediately.
guidance: USE · Settings pages and panels where a change applies immediately (enable notifications, auto-assign) / AVOID · Boolean inside a form submitted with Save → Checkbox

paperApi: tone: "success"|"warning"|"danger"|"info"|"neutral"; dot?: boolean (true); size?: "sm" 22|"md" 28 (md); children

name: Tag

name: Kbd

guidance: USE · Showing a keyboard shortcut next to a search field, menu item or in help text / AVOID · Record references → IdChip

name: Spinner
title: Spinner · Source library / variants & states

name: VisuallyHidden

name: Field

paperApi: label; hint?; error?; optional?; span?: "full"; rows? (3); resize?: "vertical" | "none" (vertical); onValueChange?; …textarea attributes

name: SelectField
title: SelectField · Source library / variants & states
description: Labelled single choice from a short fixed list: Radix Select styled as a 38px input with chevron; options show icon, description and a check. Exports type SelectOption = { value, label, icon?, description?, disabled? } shared with Combobox and MultiSelect. Experimental SelectOption.media: { src } renders a decorative saved thumbnail with initials on load failure; photos win over option icons. Single-value triggers show a compact thumbnail; MultiSelect tags retain compact text labels.
guidance: USE · Choosing one of ~3–15 known values inside a form (status, country, vendor type) / AVOID · Filtering a list/table → FilterMenu in ListToolbar (never a labelled SelectField row)

name: Combobox
title: Combobox · Source library / variants & states
description: Labelled single choice from a long list with a type-to-filter popover (Radix Popover). The trigger is a select-only combobox (role=combobox, aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded, aria-controls) named by its label. Arrow keys move, Enter selects, Escape closes the list (not the surrounding dialog). Filtering matches label or description and ranks label-starts-with, then label-contains, then description-only matches. Experimental SelectOption.media: { src } renders a decorative saved thumbnail with initials on load failure; photos win over option icons. Single-value triggers show a compact thumbnail; MultiSelect tags retain compact text labels.
guidance: USE · Choosing one of many values: city, country, vendor, customer, hotel / AVOID · Short fixed list (≤ 15) → SelectField

("No matches"); leadingIcon?: IconName; hint?; error?; disabled?; required?; optional?; name?; span?; onCreate?: (query: string) => void (experimental: "+ createLabel" action under the list, gets the typed text); createLabel? ("Create new")

name: MultiSelect
title: MultiSelect · Source library / variants & states
description: Labelled multiple choice from a long list: selected values show as removable Tags inside the control (first `max`, then "+N"); popover with filter and checkbox options. The trigger is role=combobox (aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-expanded, aria-controls) named by its label. Filtering matches label or description and ranks label-starts-with, then label-contains, then description-only matches. Experimental SelectOption.media: { src } renders a decorative saved thumbnail with initials on load failure; photos win over option icons. Single-value triggers show a compact thumbnail; MultiSelect tags retain compact text labels.
guidance: USE · Choosing several values from more than 8 options (destinations, languages, regions, team members) / AVOID · ≤ 8 options that should stay visible → ChoiceChips
paperApi: label; options: SelectOption[] (media?: { src: string }, experimental); value: string[]; onValueChange: (v: string[]) => void; placeholder?; max? (3 tags shown); searchPlaceholder?; emptyText?; hint?; error?; disabled?; required?; optional?; span?

description: Labelled civil local time HH:mm. Type an exact time or choose Hours (00–23) and Minutes (00–59) in two DS dropdowns with shared SelectField anatomy; bound/step-invalid choices are disabled; hour selection keeps the popover open and minute selection closes; 24-hour HH:mm display in every locale; hidden native validation retains min/max (including overnight windows), step and form name.
guidance: USE · Appointment, meeting, pickup or follow-up time entered separately from its date / AVOID · Picking a calendar date → DateField
paperApi: label; value?: string (HH:mm); onValueChange?: (v: string) => void; min?; max?; step? (seconds); hint?; error?; optional?; required?; disabled?; readOnly?; span?; …input attributes

ONE DS calendar picks start then end with equally selected endpoints, quick Weekend/1 week presets, clear action and min/max bounds. Inline nights summary, two-endpoint, plain field and content-width compact toolbar variants remain available.
guidance: USE · Stay dates, travel window, rate-card validity, contract period / AVOID · A single date → DateField

name: SortMenu
title: SortMenu · variants, states & source
description: 36px "Sort: Name" trigger (arrow-up-down) opening a menu of sort fields and Ascending/Descending, both as checked radio items. Collapses to icon-only in narrow toolbars.
guidance: Use: A list offers sorting beyond clicking column headers, or a card/mobile layout has no headers
Avoid: Sorting a visible DataTable column → sortable column + onSortChange

name: filterRows
title: filterRows · variants, states & source
description: Applies a FilterValue to client-side rows: AND across groups, OR within a group. Groups without an accessor or selected values are ignored.
guidance: Use: Client-side list pages with FilterMenu
Avoid: Hand-written filter loops in pages → filterRows

name: searchRows
title: searchRows · variants, states & source
description: Case-insensitive search over the fields returned for each row; every word of the query must appear.
guidance: Use: ListToolbar search on client-side lists
Avoid: Hand-written includes() search in pages → searchRows

name: sortRows
title: sortRows · variants, states & source
description: Stable sorted copy: en-IN numeric-aware collation for strings, numbers numerically, Dates and ISO date strings chronologically, empty values last. Accepts a DataTable SortState or a SortMenu value.
guidance: Use: Client-side sorting driven by DataTable onSortChange or SortMenu
Avoid: Array.sort with localeCompare in pages → sortRows

name: paginate
title: paginate · variants, states & source
description: Rows of a 1-based page, clamped to the valid range. Pair with TableFooter (and pageCount for the page count).
guidance: Use: Client-side pagination under a DataTable
Avoid: rows.slice(...) math in pages → paginate

name: PageHeader
title: PageHeader · anatomy & variants
description: Import

name: PageHeader
title: PageHeader · variants, states & source
description: Page title row (Onest 24/700, optional mono count and status, right-aligned sm actions) plus an optional ONE-line description. Two lines maximum; there is no eyebrow/kicker/overline slot. On narrow workspaces (≤ 620px) it reads title → description → actions (full-width row; 1–2 buttons share it equally, 3 keep natural widths). Experimental variant="greeting" (workspace home): a centred greeting with a date caption above it — generated from `date`, so it can only be the date line, never a free-text eyebrow — and the quick actions (Buttons size md) centred under it.
guidance: Use: Top of every list, form, settings and dashboard page (inside the template's header slot)
Avoid: Hand-built header with eyebrow + h1 + paragraph → PageHeader
states: Overflow actions in a Menu / light
Greeting with a civil date and a description / light

name: IconText
title: IconText · variants, states & source
description: Inline context icon + text (inherits size and colour) for meta rows: location with map-pin, date with calendar.
guidance: Use: RecordHeader meta items
Avoid: Table cells → IconTextCell

name: RecordHeader
title: RecordHeader · variants, states & source
description: Two-line record header: title and optional tags, then region/parent region and record metadata. Current headers omit status; deprecated status accepts frozen preview content only. Detail edit actions use tertiary Buttons. Optional moreActions renders a contextual ghost kebab beside tertiary Edit; empty/all-disabled actions omit it.
guidance: Use: Top of a vendor, service, booking, customer or package detail page (RecordPageTemplate header)
Avoid: Record page with a list-style PageHeader → RecordHeader
states: Customer with initials and a tag / light

name: Panel
title: Panel · variants, states & source
description: Bordered section card (radius lg) with a raised head (Onest 15/700 title, mono meta, actions), a 16/20 body or full-width body, and an optional footer disclosure. An EmptyState placed directly in the body (or as ItemList/DataTable `empty`) renders bare — the panel is the card.
guidance: Use: Sections of a record overview: Profile, Vendor contacts, Recent activities
Avoid: Sections of a form → FormSection
states: Padded body with a footer / light
Meta and an icon action / light

name: DescriptionList
title: DescriptionList · variants, states & source
description: Ruled key/value grid (dl/dt/dd): quiet sentence-case keys and strong values that can be nodes (StatusBadge, Avatar + name, mono IDs).
guidance: Use: Record profile fields in an Overview tab
Avoid: Editable fields → FormSection + FormGrid

name: ContactList
title: ContactList · variants, states & source
description: People to reach for a record: avatar, name, role, Primary tag and Call / Email / WhatsApp pills (tel:, mailto:, wa.me), with a 'View all N contacts' disclosure.
guidance: Use: Vendor / customer contacts in a record rail Panel
Avoid: Selecting people → Combobox/MultiSelect
states: Rail contacts, expand in place / light
View all opens another view / light

name: FileDropzone
title: FileDropzone · variants, states & source
description: Single-file drop target: dashed card with upload icon, 'Drop file or Browse' and accepted-types hint; selected state shows name, 'Ready to import · size', Replace and remove. Rejects files outside accept.
guidance: Use: Import flows (Steps inside an Import Popover)
Avoid: Image galleries / multiple uploads → a dedicated media uploader (not yet in the system; document the gap)

name: Steps
title: Steps · variants, states & source
description: Owner-selected bounded checklist rail (cards) is the default: numbered upcoming/current steps, checked completed steps, a completion count and the current upload/action area. Explicit numbered instructions, horizontal wizard and compact segmented variants remain available.
guidance: Use: Import modal (download template → upload file → review)
Avoid: Setup progress with done state → Checklist

name: Checklist
title: Checklist · variants, states & source
description: Setup checklist: title with a right-aligned '2 of 5 done' count, full-width progress bar under the header, check-circle / circle-dashed items and an action per open item. Framed as its own card by default (no Panel needed); inside a Panel body the frame drops.
guidance: Use: Finish-setup guidance on draft records
Avoid: Selecting options → Checkbox / ChoiceChips

name: ItemList
title: ItemList · variants, states & source
description: Header-less ruled rows for rails and panels: [16px muted icon] label 13.5/500 (+ quiet meta line) · right-aligned value (mono optional, blank → '—') · one trailing action (IconButton xs ghost). 48px min rows, hairlines, 20px panel gutter; the value drops under the label below 320px. Values stay aligned when only some rows have actions. Long values (account numbers, e-mails) wrap inside a column capped at 60% of the row, so they never squeeze the label.
guidance: Use: Important dates, bank details, travel documents summary in a record rail
Avoid: Tabular data with sortable columns → DataTable

name: PersonInline
title: PersonInline · variants, states & source
description: Avatar (xs 20 / sm 26, person-pink by default) + name 13.5/600 (+ optional micro subtitle) inline, for detail lists: Owner, Assignee, Created by. Decorative avatar; the name is the text.
guidance: Use: Owner / assignee / relationship manager values in a DescriptionList or ItemList
Avoid: Table cells → PersonCell
states: Owner in a detail list / light
Owner in a detail list / dark

name: Money
title: Money · variants, states & source
description: Money in mono tabular figures with Indian grouping via @paryatech/format (₹4,20,100); paise only when non-zero unless decimals="always"; success/danger/muted tones; sizes sm (12) · md (13.5, default) · lg (15) · xl (fluid 18–22) from the type scale; compact notation (₹4.2L, exact amount in the tooltip and for screen readers); struck for a previous price (<s>, announced "was ₹…"). Experimental `masked`: "••••" announced "Amount hidden" for a hide-amounts eye button (privacy screen, not cost hiding).
guidance: Use: Any amount outside a DataTable cell: KpiStrip values, DescriptionList values, totals
Avoid: Table cells → MoneyCell

name: DateText
title: DateText · variants, states & source
description: A civil date (YYYY-MM-DD, never timezone-shifted) or an instant (IST) in a <time> element: '12 Dec 2026', with optional time or relative ('3 months ago').
guidance: Use: Dates in DescriptionList values, meta rows, panels
Avoid: Table cells → DateCell
states: Relative to a pinned now / light

name: Banner
title: Banner · variants, states & source
description: Deprecated compatibility for frozen historical previews. For new work use toast or accessible inline alert/status text. Flash banner with a 3px tone rule on a tinted status surface: title, optional body, one action and Dismiss. role=status (alert for danger). Below 560px of its own width (phones, 360px rails) the action moves under the text so the title keeps the full width.
guidance: Use: Rendering an existing frozen historical preview only
Avoid: New screens or updated references → toast or accessible inline alert/status text

name: SummaryStrip
title: SummaryStrip · variants, states & source
description: Deprecated compatibility for frozen historical previews. For new work use KpiStrip with real scoped navigation. Ruled KPI strip: 48px pink icon tiles, overline labels (never clipped), Onest/mono values coloured by tone, hints. Columns follow the strip's own width: 4 → 2 at ≤ 900px; ≤ 620px every strip is 2 compact columns (small inline icon); 1 column only at ≤ 340px — an 8-item strip is 4 short rows on a phone. Bleeds to the page edges inside RecordOverviewLayout and DashboardPageTemplate.
guidance: Use: Rendering an existing frozen historical preview only
Avoid: New screens or updated references → KpiStrip with real scoped navigation

title: 06.01 · Shell anatomy & navigation
description: Start with AppShell. The sidebar card and workspace card form the agency work frame.

name: TabBar
title: TabBar · primary counts · Light
description: Use for page and record sections. Pink marks selection in both primary (44px) and secondary (40px). Avoid settings section forms → SettingsPageTemplate nav.

name: AppShell
title: AppShell · full-shell · Light
description: Sidebar card + workspace card. Source measured at 1376 × 800px. Navigation rows 35px; workspace topbar 57px; shell gap 10px.

name: Breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs · source variants & states
description: "CRM › Vendors" trail in the topbar: 13.5px, links secondary, current page 600 with aria-current=page. When the trail does not fit, crumbs collapse from the front into a "…" button whose menu lists (and navigates to) the hidden crumbs; the parent goes before the current page is truncated, so the current page always gets the most room.
guidance: Use: Always through AppShell `breadcrumbs` — [Module, Page] on lists, [Module, List, Record] on records
Avoid: Rendering <Breadcrumbs> inside page content → pass breadcrumbs to AppShell

name: BackButton
title: BackButton · source variants & states
description: 36px bordered chevron-left button left of the breadcrumbs on record, detail and create pages.
guidance: Use: Through AppShell `onBack` (+ optional backLabel "Back to vendors")
Avoid: A "Back" text button in page content → AppShell onBack

name: NotesStrip
title: NotesStrip · source variants & states
description: Sidebar strip (38px) that opens the module/record notes panel, with a "+" to write a note and an optional count.
guidance: Use: Through AppShell `notes` — "Module notes" on list pages, "Vendor notes" etc. on records
Avoid: Anywhere else → AppShell notes + NotesPanel

name: CreditsMeter
title: CreditsMeter · source variants & states
description: Sidebar credit usage as a clamped percentage and usage bar beside an accessible primary plus icon upgrade control on the same row. Collapsed rail puts usage in its tooltip.
guidance: Use: Through AppShell `credits`
Avoid: Usage/quota bars in page content → Meter

name: TabBar
title: TabBar · source variants & states
description: Underlined tab row with counts ("Vendors 12 | Services 11"). Optional showZeroCounts preserves explicit zero counts for filtered lists; otherwise zero and omitted counts are hidden. primary 44px/13.5px for page and record sections; secondary 40px/12.5px with icons for categories inside a section. Pink active tab in both. Arrow-key roving focus; scrolls horizontally with faded edges when it overflows. Keeps the selected tab clear of fades on initialization, selection and layout/font changes without scrolling the page or interrupting manual scrolling.
guidance: Use: Categorical views of the same list with counts (Vendors / Services)
Avoid: Switching a form value or a small view mode (List | Grid) → SegmentedControl

name: Pagination
title: Pagination · source variants & states
description: 30px mono pager: previous/next chevrons, pages with ellipses (1 … 4 5 6 … 20), pink current page with aria-current=page.
guidance: Use: Paging outside a table (card grids, search results)
Avoid: Table footers → TableFooter, which wraps Pagination with "Showing 1–12 of 12 vendors"

name: Sidebar
title: Sidebar Â· Light source states
description: App sidebar with grouped navigation and collapsible child destinations: active parent is pink, selected child has a teal outline. Parent navigation and disclosure are separate. Open records start collapsed at the bottom above the footer; navigation scrolls independently. Icon rail exposes children in a navigation popover.
guidance: Use: Only inside AppShell (it renders it for you)
Avoid: Any product screen → AppShell navGroups/activeNavId
states: Sidebar Â· child-navigation Â· source specimen
Sidebar Â· child-navigation-folded Â· source specimen
Sidebar Â· child-navigation-supply Â· source specimen
Sidebar Â· child-navigation-rail Â· source specimen
Sidebar Â· child-navigation-short Â· source specimen

name: Topbar
title: Topbar · Light source states
description: The 57px workspace topbar AppShell renders: [menu on mobile] [back] breadcrumbs … search trigger (Ctrl/⌘ K), help, notifications bell, account menu. Exported for completeness.
guidance: Use: Only inside AppShell (it renders it for you)
Avoid: Page title and actions → PageHeader in the page

name: AccountMenu
title: AccountMenu · Light source states
description: Topbar account button (avatar + chevron, pink border) and launcher menu, built on Menu: identity header (Menu `header`: avatar, name, subtitle) above rich rows with a trailing chevron; destructive "Sign out" always last. Optional third header line (`meta`, e.g. the email under "Owner · Sharma Travels") and a footer with the Theme switch (Light · Dark · System) and Shortcuts, all arrow-key reachable.
guidance: Use: Through AppShell `account` — items like My profile, Security and sign-in, Devices and sessions, Personal preferences, Sign out (destructive)
Avoid: Row or record actions → Menu

name: NotificationsPanel
title: NotificationsPanel · Light source states
description: Notification center body: Unread/All filter, Mark all as read, items (title, body, "Mentions · 12 min ago" meta, unread tint) and footer links. AppShell shows it in a 480px popover from the bell.
guidance: Use: Pass as AppShell `notifications.panel` (the bell opens it)
Avoid: Transient confirmations → toast()

name: OpenRecordsList
title: OpenRecordsList · Light source states
description: The member's open records inside the sidebar card (AppShell `openRecords`): DS nav-item rows (type icon + title; × on hover; orange dot for unsaved work), a collapsible header (chevron · title · count · ⋯ Show all / Close others / Reopen / Close all), drag and Alt+↑/↓ reorder. Starts collapsed at the bottom above the sidebar footer. Navigation scrolls independently; the expanded record list is bounded and scrolls itself. In the collapsed rail it is one icon with a popover list.
guidance: Use: Agency apps where people keep several queries, bookings or customers open while they work (records open into the list instead of replacing the page)
Avoid: Saved views or module sections → Sidebar navGroups

name: Modal
title: Modal · edit-small · Light
description: Medium content that fits without scrolling. Header → body → right-aligned footer. Source sm width 480px. Avoid deep previews and long forms → full page.

name: Modal
title: Modal · source variants & states
description: Centered dialog: subtle header (Onest title, optional description, close) · optional section jump nav · scrolling body · right-aligned footer. Focus is trapped and returned; Escape and scrim click close. FormSection titles inside become h3 (the dialog title is the h2). Escape in a non-empty SearchField or an open Combobox/Select list closes that first. Overlay hierarchy (owner, 2026-10-06): small → Popover; medium, no scrolling → Modal; anything that would scroll → a full page; Drawer → the notifications panel only.
guidance: Use: Confirm or edit ≤ 4 fields (size sm)
Avoid: Content that would scroll → a full page (FormPageTemplate / RecordPageTemplate)

name: Sheet
title: Sheet · source variants & states
description: Full-height side panel from the right edge with the Modal anatomy (header · scrolling body · footer). Keeps the list visible behind a scrim. FormSection titles inside become h3 (the dialog title is the h2). Escape in a non-empty SearchField or an open Combobox/Select list closes that first. Avoid in product screens: Overlay hierarchy (owner, 2026-10-06): small → Popover; medium, no scrolling → Modal; anything that would scroll → a full page; Drawer → the notifications panel only.
guidance: Use: Creating a record with 5–15 fields from a list page (New rate card, Add contact)
Avoid: Product screens (owner rule 2026-10-06) → Modal for medium content that fits without scrolling, a full page (FormPageTemplate) for anything that scrolls

name: Popover
title: Popover · source variants & states
description: Anchored panel for a small task beside its trigger, with optional title header (close button) and a footer band. Escape and outside click close; focus returns to the trigger by default. Optional lifecycle handlers support a compact picker beside an external search without moving that input into the panel.
guidance: Use: Anchored mini-task like Import (Steps + FileDropzone), width="lg" with title and footer
Avoid: Medium content (a short form, a list that needs the screen's attention) → Modal; anything that scrolls → a full page

name: Menu
title: Menu · source variants & states
description: Action menu from a trigger. Items are data (MenuItem[]): icon + label, optional description (account-style rich rows), shortcut hint, trailing chevron for rows that open another page (`navigates`), labels as overline group headings, checkbox items and radio groups with a leading check column, and an optional non-interactive `header` (identity block). Destructive items are always moved to a final red group behind an automatic separator.
guidance: Use: Row actions in a table (IconButton "more-vertical" → Menu); DataTable rowActions builds this for you
Avoid: Choosing a form value → SelectField

name: ConfirmDialog
title: ConfirmDialog · source variants & states
description: Small alert dialog asking the user to confirm one action: title question, consequence, Cancel + danger/primary confirm. Awaits an async onConfirm with a loading button and blocks dismissal until it settles.
guidance: Use: Before a destructive or irreversible action (delete, archive, cancel booking)
Avoid: Collecting more than a reason field → Modal size="sm"

name: CommandPalette
title: CommandPalette · source variants & states
description: Universal search (Cmd/Ctrl+K): dialog near the top with a 58px search input, results grouped under overline labels (icon tile, Onest label, description, "Open" hint on the active row), ↑↓ Enter Esc key hints. Filters label, description and keywords case-insensitively. v2 (additive): mono codes, key hints and a verb per row, Ctrl/⌘ Enter alternative action (open in background), scope chips (Tab cycles), a controlled query for app-built results, a preview pane of the active row and a loading state.
guidance: Use: Topbar "Search anything" / Ctrl K: jump to pages, records and settings
Avoid: Searching within one list → ListToolbar search (SearchField)

name: Drawer
title: Drawer · source variants & states
description: Right-edge notifications surface with no built-in header, padding or footer. Default modal: scrim, focus trap, Esc/scrim close. Opt-in nonmodal: labelled region, focus enters, Tab leaves, page stays interactive without closing it, Esc/close returns focus to the opener. Full screen at 640px and below in both modes; supply a visible close button. Reduced motion skips the slide.
guidance: Use: The notifications panel — nothing else
Avoid: Anything other than notifications (owner rule) → Popover (small), Modal (medium, no scrolling) or a full page (scrolls)

name: toast
title: toast · source variants & states
description: Imperative feedback after an action: toast({ title, description?, tone?, action? }). Renders in the Toaster (bottom-right, 360px), auto-dismisses after 5s, pauses on hover/focus, announced politely (danger assertively).
guidance: Use: Confirming an action finished ("Vendor saved", tone success)
Avoid: Validation errors in an open form → field error props

name: Toaster
title: Toaster · source variants & states
description: Mount point that renders toasts raised with toast(). Portalled bottom-right stack at --pt-z-toast.
guidance: Use: Mount once at the app root — AppShell already mounts it; only mount it yourself outside AppShell
Avoid: Mounting it per page or inside AppShell pages → it is already there; call toast()

name: KanbanSignal
title: KanbanSignal · variants, states & source
description: Named due/age/flag signal with complete accessible date/state. Default preserves StatusChip semantics and appearance; appearance="card" is a24px rounded reference capsule with pale upcoming due and solid overdue. describeKanbanSignal keeps the same classification for tables and filters.
guidance: Use: Deadlines or transient workflow flags on KanbanCard → use appearance="card" for the owner reference anatomy
Avoid: Fixed domain statuses (booking, payment, vendor…) → StatusBadge

name: StageLabel
title: StageLabel · variants, states & source
description: 8px tone dot + label for a workspace-configurable stage (New, Quoting, Options sent, Vouchers pending). md 13.5/600 for column headers; sm 12.5/500 for table cells and previews. Takes the board column ({ label, tone }).
guidance: Use: Stage column in a DataTable list view of a board
Avoid: Fixed domain statuses → StatusBadge; configurable stages → StageLabel
states: Stage column in the list view / light
Stage next to a domain status / light
Stage column in the list view / dark

name: PriorityDot
title: PriorityDot · variants, states & source
description: Accessible named priority marker. Default preserves8px urgent/high/medium/low vocabulary. Card appearance uses a solid10px marker and is selected by standard KanbanCard; name and tooltip always identify the level.
guidance: Use: Priority on a KanbanCard (KanbanCard priority prop renders it)
Avoid: Priority as a table column or filter option → EnumLabel / IconTextCell with PRIORITY_LEVELS[p].icon + label (text, not colour only)
states: Before a title in a compact list / light

name: BoardViewSwitch
title: BoardViewSwitch · variants, states & source
description: Board | List SegmentedControl (36px toolbar, icons board / list, named "View") for the ListToolbar actions slot: the same filtered, sorted records as a KanbanBoard or a DataTable.
guidance: Use: A list page that offers both a board and a table of the same records
Avoid: Other view modes (Week | Month, Cost | Sell) → SegmentedControl

name: KanbanCard
title: KanbanCard · variants, states & source
description: Standard reference-led card with natural content height: code/priority, one resting title line that expands fully in normal flow,24px deadline and structured related-record capsule, mono short age, rounded chip24 assignees with accessible overflow. Related contextLabel is separate from label and native href. Pointer preview follows50ms entry/300ms expansion/1500ms hold/300ms collapse; focus and touch retain full text, reduced motion is immediate. Rich/compact retain their supported anatomy. Inside Board canonical source IDs, Move/Open/Pin menus, keyboard dragging, async pending and readOnly remain meaningful. Current DS Public Sans is the owner-selected font adaptation.
guidance: Use: Rendering an item in KanbanBoard renderCard
Avoid: Generic content cards or panels → Panel
states: Owner reference · structured related record / light
Owner reference · structured related record / dark

name: EventRow
title: EventRow · variants, states & source
description: One agenda line: time column ("10:30–11:00", "Departs · 5 days", "Due", or for overdue "20 Sep · 7 days late"), a kind icon tile tinted by EVENT_KINDS tone (danger when overdue, muted when settled, dashed when pending/on hold, struck through when cancelled), title + meta with a mono reference; narrow subtitles wrap to two lines, StatusBadge, Money, owner Avatar and trailing actions. With onOpen/href the title stretches over the whole row (one target) while actions stay clickable. Below 520px status and amount drop under the title.
guidance: Use: Rendering a CalendarEvent outside the Agenda (Sheet lists, popovers, a booking's upcoming items)
Avoid: A whole schedule → Agenda (it renders EventRows with day headings and list semantics)

name: AgendaSummary
title: AgendaSummary · variants, states & source
description: "Next 7 days" at a glance: ItemList rows per event kind with the count (payments: the ₹ total due and number of payments) and the next date ("Today" or "Next: Tue, 29 Sep"). Counts stay on the title line in narrow rails; the next date sits below. Cancelled events are not counted. Put it in <Panel title="Next 7 days" padding="none">.
guidance: Use: Rail summary beside an Agenda
Avoid: Page-level KPIs with icons and tones in the dashboard kpis slot → KpiStrip

name: MiniCalendar
title: MiniCalendar · variants, states & source
description: Month grid date navigator: "Sep 2026" title with previous/next, Su–Sa headers, event dots with counts in each day's name, neutral today underline (aria-current="date"), pink selected day, an optional teal range band (the agenda window), min/max disabled days, and an optional collapse to one week. APG date-grid keyboard: arrows (day/week), Home/End (week edges), PageUp/PageDown (month; Shift = year), Enter/Space select; one tab stop. Civil dates only.
guidance: Use: Jumping an Agenda to a day (rail Panel on the schedule page)
Avoid: Entering a date in a form → DateField / DateRangeField
states: Variation A · month with activity / light
Variation D · quick date popover / light
Variation A · month with activity / dark

name: Agenda
title: Agenda · variants, states & source
description: Day-grouped schedule: kind chips with icons + counts (All · Departures · Returns · Payments due · Tasks · Meetings · Follow-ups; [] = all), an "Overdue" group pinned on top (unsettled payments/tasks/follow-ups dated before today, with "N days late"), then one section per day with sticky h2 headings ("Today · Sun, 27 Sep", "Tomorrow · Mon, 28 Sep", holidays/peaks as markers) and EventRows as a list. Mixed event types from the closed EVENT_KINDS vocabulary; civil YYYY-MM-DD dates never shift time zone. Built-in loading skeleton, first-use empty, kind no-results ("Show all types"), empty period and an "End of schedule" line. Below 640px it shows its own collapsible week strip (MiniCalendar) and the chips scroll sideways. Its own card surface: place it directly in a template slot, never inside a Panel (Panel clips sticky headings).
guidance: Use: "What's next / what's overdue" across departures, returns, payments due, tasks, meetings and follow-ups
Avoid: Tabular records with sorting, selection or bulk actions → DataTable (e.g. a departures register)

name: AreaChart
title: AreaChart · variants, states & source
description: Volume over time (monthly "YYYY-MM" or daily "YYYY-MM-DD" periods) on TanStack Charts, themed to Paryatech: token palette, subtle grid, compact INR axis (₹4.2L, ₹1.2Cr), en-IN period ticks ("Oct 2025 · Nov …"), crosshair + grouped surface-card tooltip with mono values, keyboard focus, screen-reader data table. Overlapping by default (first series filled, later series as lines); stacked for part-to-whole.
guidance: Use: Revenue, cost, bookings or collections per month
Avoid: Rates or values that do not add up (margin %, conversion) → LineChart

name: LineChart
title: LineChart · variants, states & source
description: Trend of 1–8 series over time; same data shape, axes, tooltip, keyboard and screen-reader table as AreaChart but lines only — for values compared by position rather than area (percentages, averages, rates). null y values render as gaps.
guidance: Use: Gross margin %, conversion rate, average booking value over time
Avoid: Money or counts that accumulate → AreaChart

name: BarChart
title: BarChart · variants, states & source
description: Compare values across categories on TanStack Charts: vertical or horizontal, single, grouped or stacked, rounded value ends, 2px surface gaps, hover band + grouped tooltip, keyboard focus, screen-reader table (with Total when stacked). The category axis is HTML so categories can carry an IconName (service types, customer types); narrow bands show the icon only. colorScheme="ordinal" paints ordered series (ageing buckets) as one teal ramp.
guidance: Use: Bookings by service type (icons from SERVICE_TYPES), revenue by destination ranked, supplier spend
Avoid: Change over months → AreaChart or LineChart

name: BarList
title: BarList · variants, states & source
description: Ranked or ordered horizontal bar list where every row can drill: label (truncates) · 8px pill bar (share of the largest value) · mono value (money compact "₹48L", exact in the row's name) · optional secondary column (count or <Money notation="compact"/>). Plain semantic HTML (a <ul> named by the ChartCard title), not a TanStack chart; fits a third-width ChartCard and hides the secondary column below 280px. onSelect turns rows into buttons (zero rows disabled); maskValues hides amounts for the Home privacy screen.
guidance: Use: Pipeline by stage with trip counts and quoted value, each stage opening its filtered list
Avoid: Trends over time → AreaChart or LineChart

name: DonutChart
title: DonutChart · variants, states & source
description: Share of one total: donut (TanStack polar pie + radialArc) with the compact total in the centre, a list legend with exact value and share per slice (icons allowed), 2px slice gaps. More than 6 slices → the 6 largest stay (in caller order, colour follows the entity) and the rest fold into a neutral "Other". Hover/arrow keys move the centre readout to the focused slice (announced politely).
guidance: Use: Revenue by destination, bookings by channel, services by type — one total, ≤ 6 meaningful parts
Avoid: Comparing parts precisely or more than 6 parts → BarChart horizontal

name: Sparkline
title: Sparkline · variants, states & source
description: Tiny inline trend without axes or interaction (TanStack Charts line + soft area + end dot), filling its container: md 36px for standalone ChartCard trends, sm 24px for DataTable cells. Accessible name = label + spoken first → last summary ("₹38L to ₹53L, up 39%").
guidance: Use: A compact trend in a standalone ChartCard or a DataTable cell; never inside KpiStrip
Avoid: Anyone needs values, axes or tooltips → LineChart in a ChartCard

name: ChartCard
title: ChartCard · variants, states & source
description: Card for one chart on a dashboard or report: Onest title + one-line description, optional period SegmentedControl slot and actions, a compact mono headline value with quiet trend text (arrow icon + %, coloured by goodWhen); metric labels stay sentence case and controls wrap together on narrow cards, the chart, an optional footer. Same border/radius/surface as Panel without the raised head. The chart inside takes the card title as its accessible name and the card's loading state (skeletons).
guidance: Use: Any chart on a page (Reports, dashboard main/rail columns)
Avoid: KPI numbers without a chart → KpiStrip
states: Revenue card with period switch / light
Trend where down is good / light
Trend going the wrong way / light
Revenue card with period switch / dark

name: PriceChip
title: PriceChip · variants, states & source
description: A price with its change against a previous version: mono INR amount + a toned pill "↑ 8.6%" / "↓ 4.2%" / "–" / "New". Tone follows goodDirection (default "down" for vendor costs: up = warning, down = success). Screen readers hear "up 8.6% from v3 (₹7,000)". Internal pricing only.
guidance: Use: A cost or sell column in a DataTable that should show movement since the last rate-card version (supplements, versions, vendor comparisons)
Avoid: A plain amount → Money (text) or MoneyCell (tables)

name: SeasonHeader
title: SeasonHeader · variants, states & source
description: Season name and dates on one horizontal line, with a tone swatch (peak/high/shoulder/low), compact mono date-range chips ("20 Dec – 5 Jan") and a red blackout count; full dates with years, blackout reasons and the optional season rule are in accessible text and hover details. It is RateMatrix's column-group header; use it alone where a season is labelled outside the grid (quote lines, test-rate results).
guidance: Use: Labelling a season with its dates outside a RateMatrix (e.g. a night-by-night price breakdown)
Avoid: Inside a RateMatrix → pass the season as a group; the matrix renders SeasonHeader itself

name: SeasonLegend
title: SeasonLegend · variants, states & source
description: Key for a rate card's seasons: swatch, name, every date range, duration count (nights by default, days for service coverage), the season rule ("Overrides High") and each blackout with its reason. A wrapping standalone list outside a RateMatrix; matrix column headers already carry season details.
guidance: Use: A standalone season key outside a RateMatrix, where overlapping seasons, priorities and blackout dates are the content
Avoid: Blackout dates as the main content of a section → ItemList in a Panel (icon ban, reason, mono date)

name: RateVersionBar
title: RateVersionBar · variants, states & source
description: Version switcher and publish state for a versioned rate card, above its RateMatrix: "Version v4" menu (radio list with status, date and change note), StatusBadge domain=rateCard, a summary ("Published 12 Aug 2026 · Peak +6%", "Superseded by v4", or "3 unsaved changes"), error/warning counts, then Discard changes (only with changes) and optional Publish.
guidance: Use: A rate card (or any versioned price list) whose versions can be browsed, edited as a draft and published
Avoid: The full version history with authors and counts → DataTable (Versions tab) with StatusBadge domain="rateCard"

name: RateMatrix
title: RateMatrix · variants, states & source
description: Spreadsheet-like price grid for a vendor rate card: rows (room types, vehicle types, activity slots; optional group headers and icons) × column groups (seasons with date ranges and blackouts) × sub-columns (meal plans CP/MAP/AP, occupancy Single/Double/Extra bed, trip types). Mono right-aligned INR, '—' for unpriced cells, sticky row column and header rows, horizontal scroll with faded edges, hairline grid. view | edit modes; cost | sell display (sell shows a margin % hint; derived from markupPercent unless a cell overrides it). Edit mode: role=grid keyboard model (arrows, Shift+arrows select, Home/End, Enter/F2/typing edit, Enter/Tab commit and move, Escape cancel, Delete clears), paste tab-separated blocks from Excel/Sheets (one value fills a selected range), Ctrl+C copies, row Menu (copy first season to all seasons, copy row, clear row). Highlights cells changed against `baseline`; flags negative amounts (error) and sell below cost (warning). INTERNAL ONLY.
guidance: Use: Viewing or editing a rate card's prices by season × meal plan / occupancy / trip type
Avoid: A list of rate cards (name, validity, status) → DataTable with StatusBadge domain="rateCard"
states: Room rates in a panel / light
Change against the previous version / light
Room rates in a panel / dark

name: ListPageTemplate
title: ListPageTemplate · source list screen
description: Use for a collection: PageHeader → TabBar → one-row ListToolbar → edge-to-edge DataTable → bulk dock and TableFooter. Header, breadcrumb and primary action name the same thing.

name: RecordPageTemplate
title: RecordPageTemplate · Light source states
description: Record detail layout: RecordHeader → 12 → (inline feedback) → TabBar → 20 → labelled tab body. Nested lists (DataTable, TableFooter) in the body bleed like a list page; nothing in the template clips overflow, so a direct-child `<TableFooter sticky />` stays pinned to the bottom of the viewport.
guidance: Use: Any record detail page: vendor, service, booking, customer, package
Avoid: Record page with a list-style PageHeader → RecordHeader

name: RecordOverviewLayout
title: RecordOverviewLayout · Light source states
description: Overview tab body: KpiStrip (full width, rules bled to the workspace edges) → 20 → [main 2fr | rail 320–360px]; the rail stacks under 1000px workspace width.
guidance: Use: Overview tab of a record page
Avoid: Custom wrappers with margins between regions → the template owns spacing

name: FormPageTemplate
title: FormPageTemplate · Light source states
description: Create page: 64px raised header band with PageHeader, optional inline feedback (gutter strip under the band), edge-to-edge FormSections, sticky FormFooter (Cancel, primary Create). Optional onSubmit wraps sections + footer in a <form>.
guidance: Use: Full-page creation and long or deep record editing. Source example: more than ~15 fields or several sections; field count is not a universal surface rule.

name: SettingsPageTemplate
title: SettingsPageTemplate · Light source states
description: Settings layout: PageHeader → 20 → [240px section nav (icon tile + label + description, active = pink selected) | content]. Nav becomes a horizontal row under 760px.
guidance: Use: Workspace or module settings with several sections (Organization, Team & permissions, Brand kit)
Avoid: Custom wrappers with margins between regions → the template owns spacing

name: DashboardPageTemplate
title: DashboardPageTemplate · Light source states
description: Dashboard layout: PageHeader → 16 → KPI KpiStrip (bled) → 20 → [main 2fr | rail 1fr], stacked under 1000px.
guidance: Use: Home and module overview pages with KPIs and work queues
Avoid: Custom wrappers with margins between regions → the template owns spacing

name: Icon
title: Icon · exact SVG inventory / 24-grid
description: 151 exact SVG glyphs · closed IconName vocabulary · 24 × 24 viewBox

name: ServiceTypeLabel
title: ServiceTypeLabel · source variants & states
description: One service type rendered as its canonical icon + label from SERVICE_TYPES. The travel vocabulary: accommodation (hotel), transport (car), activity → "Activities" (compass), flight → "Flights" (plane), visa (id-card), addon → "Add-ons" (package-plus), insurance (shield-check), cruise (ship), rail (train), meal → "Meals" (utensils), guide → "Guides" (flag).
guidance: Use: Showing the type of a service, rate card, booking line or package component
Avoid: Never render a service type as plain text or with an ad-hoc icon → ServiceTypeLabel

name: ServiceTypeList
title: ServiceTypeList · source variants & states
description: Inline, de-duplicated list of ServiceTypeLabels on ONE line (never wraps): beyond `max` (3) the rest collapse into a muted "+N" pill with a tooltip (and screen-reader text) naming them. The pill never shrinks; the last visible label ellipsises first. Give the column ≥ 260px at size sm for 3 labels. Em dash when empty.
guidance: Use: "Services offered" column in a vendor table (size="sm")
Avoid: Never join service types into a comma string ("Hotel, Car, Flights") → ServiceTypeList

name: EnumLabel
title: EnumLabel · source variants & states
description: Generic icon + label for one value of a closed vocabulary; the base of ServiceTypeLabel, VendorTypeLabel, CustomerTypeLabel and QueryTypeLabel. Icon is muted and decorative; label 13.5px/600 (md) or 12.5px/600 (sm).
guidance: Use: A value from a domain map that has no dedicated label component, e.g. IMPORTANT_DATE_TYPES: <EnumLabel icon={IMPORTANT_DATE_TYPES.birthday.icon} label={IMPORTANT_DATE_TYPES.birthday.label} />
Avoid: Service / vendor / customer / query types → ServiceTypeLabel, VendorTypeLabel, CustomerTypeLabel, QueryTypeLabel

name: VendorTypeLabel
title: VendorTypeLabel · source variants & states
description: A vendor type from VENDOR_TYPES as its canonical icon + label (Direct supplier, DMC, Wholesaler, Airline, Hotel chain, Transporter, Activity operator, Visa agent).
guidance: Use: Vendor type column, vendor record meta, DescriptionList value
Avoid: Never render a vendor type as plain text or with an ad-hoc icon → VendorTypeLabel

name: CustomerTypeLabel
title: CustomerTypeLabel · source variants & states
description: A customer type from CUSTOMER_TYPES as icon + label: b2c "B2C" (user), b2b "B2B agent" (handshake), sub-agent "Sub-agent" (users), corporate "Corporate" (building). Also drives customer list tabs and filters (CUSTOMER_TYPE_IDS).
guidance: Use: Customer category column, record header meta, DescriptionList value
Avoid: Never hand-write "B2B", "Agent", "Retail" labels → CUSTOMER_TYPES / CustomerTypeLabel

name: TierBadge
title: TierBadge · source variants & states
description: An agency-defined tier name with a semantic preset or validated full #RRGGBB record colour. Neutral semantic label text stays readable in both themes; custom dots are outlined.
guidance: Use: Tier column in the customers table
Avoid: Record workflow state → use StatusBadge

name: QueryTypeLabel
title: QueryTypeLabel · source variants & states
description: A sales query type from QUERY_TYPES as icon + label: trip "Trip" (luggage), flight, accommodation, visa, cruise, transport (same glyphs as the matching service types).
guidance: Use: Query type column, query record meta, new-query type picker options
Avoid: Never render a query type as plain text or pick its icon → QueryTypeLabel

name: DocumentTypeTile
title: DocumentTypeTile · source variants & states
description: 32×32 (or 40×40 `size="lg"`) mono code tile leading a row in document lists; accessible name is the full type label. Data: DOCUMENT_TYPES (label, icon, code) — traveller/booking: passport PASS, visa VISA, pan PAN, aadhaar AADH, photo PHOT, insurance INSU, ticket TKT, voucher VCHR, invoice INV; vendor compliance: gst-certificate GST, agreement AGMT, trade-licence TL, cancelled-cheque CHQ, msme MSME (+ insurance); other DOC.
guidance: Use: Leading media of a document row in the document vault, traveller documents, vendor compliance documents or a booking's documents
Avoid: Never draw your own code box or file icon in a document row → DocumentTypeTile

name: StatusBadge
title: StatusBadge · source variants & states
description: A domain status as a StatusChip (pill with dot) using the canonical label and tone. Tones: success = Active/Published/Confirmed/Completed/Paid/Settled/Done/Won/Verified; warning = Draft/In progress/Pending/Upcoming/Part paid/Quoted/On hold; danger = Expired/Blocked/Overdue/Cancelled/Lost/Failed/Missing; info = Open/New/On trip/To collect/Due/Sent/Lead/Scheduled/Invited; neutral = Inactive/Archived/Refunded/Void/Deactivated. warning also covers invoice Partially paid; danger covers member Suspended. Document readiness roll-ups use domain="document" (ready, action-needed, expiring-soon, expired, missing); ledger entries use domain="ledger" (credit = payment received → success, debit → info, refund → warning, adjustment → neutral). Team members use domain="member" (active success, invited info, deactivated neutral, suspended danger).
guidance: Use: Status column in any DataTable
Avoid: Never pick a status colour by hand or pass a tone to StatusChip for a domain status → StatusBadge

name: CustomerTierDialog
title: CustomerTierDialog · source variants & states
description: Add an agency-defined customer tier in a compact non-scrolling modal, with required name, native colour chooser, full hex input and readable live badge preview.
guidance: Use: Creating a customer tier from agency settings or a tier selector
Avoid: Selecting an existing tier → use SelectField

name: ActivityTable
title: ActivityTable · source pattern
description: Use for immutable, viewer-scoped activity. Heading → search and Filters → Date / Activity / By / Actions rows → history footer. Recent shows at most four matches without a footer.
